payload.text: devbin 0.1.20, hv 2026-11-04 (devbin-vc's decision 133 agrees): the formula line-length fix, devbin#0322, plus Devbin's main since v0.1.19 (0320 included); the 19 open issues wait. devbin-dc, under pplr-vc: unit 28f94c39 on 64566fba, banked, unpushed. Its arm runs brew style itself: red at main (131/118), green at the fix, BSD and GNU. Fleet proof clean: brew style and brew audit --strict on pplr 2.0.2's, cldr 0.2.2's and ccusage 0.1.8's renders, in a scratch trust store (hv's choice a), with ~/.homebrew/trust.json unchanged (vc checked e0f6ec4b). Next, at hv's return: dc's run on vc's desk (bats lane); devbin-vc lands it with land-stack.sh and 0322 closes in the next commit; hv's cut, which needs kovacs up with kovacs-sysadm and CI's whole matrix; hv's brew upgrade devbin, then devbin use brew; devbin-vc's sweep vendors 0.1.20 fleet-wide; hv republishes the three taps, and homebrew-cldr's and homebrew-ccusage's CI exceptions go.
